contracts.originalDraws: Normal water and swept shader text, custom shader keys, original depth/colour/side, geometry and render orders remain unchanged. Only successful fragment/depth tests replace stencil bit1. Stencil failure and depth failure keep it.
contracts.lateRepair: Two identity children (coarse and Rich patch) share their original geometry and one cloned water material. Exactly the original mask-rejected predicate, including active guard, replaces only WATER_BARREL_DISCARD. Rich patch/skirt and wet/dry clipping, body optics and source uniforms remain original. Stencil equality0/readmask1/writeMask0 prevents repair covering original water/swept samples. Render order1 follows all ordinary opaque water/swept order0 draws.
contracts.clear: Actual main renderer requests stencil and opts in only if its default context confirms it. Three defaults autoClear=true/autoClearStencil=true and clearStencil=0; its clear resets stencil write mask before clearing despite the last read-only fallback draw. Exact GPU clear provenance and active→inactive→active controls remain pending held QA.
contracts.dynamicState: Mask enable/null, supported flag, coarse-grid/window rebuild and look changes sync WaterSurface repair state. Swept update/hide and explicitly versioned cached draw sync coverage marking without rebuilding or uploading geometry. Unsupported/inactive paths mark nothing and hide repairs. Getters do not allocate.
contracts.allocation: No additional mesh/material construction in inactive constructors. Repair material/two meshes allocated only at first supported active mask; subsequent mask/held-source transitions reuse them. Extra first-active UUID randomness is acknowledged; no claim of later unseeded global RNG parity.
contracts.lifecycle: Original coarse/patch geometries remain shared and disposed exactly once; the repair material shared by both children is disposed once. Children are detached at WaterSurface disposal. Source/envMap rotation/intensity/roughness/version and receiveShadow sync before drawing. No prepass, no second loft/contact build, no optics tuning.
